fichas.title: Hotel rooms: planning and room types
fichas.summary: Hotel rooms are a major part of a hotel's area and an important factor in guest evaluation. Planning balances economic and technical requirements with comfort, spatial division, individuality, and identity. The page illustrates room layouts, bathrooms between rooms, bed spacing, accessible accommodation, apartments, suites, and a DEHOGA classification excerpt.

The caption identifies them as three-star hotel rooms according to DEHOGA classification. Further diagrams show bathroom arrangements between rooms and minimum distances between beds.
